home.title: Home
home.subtitle: Pick up where you left off, or find something new.
home.search_hint: Search games, or paste a game link / place ID
home.no_results_hint: Try a different name or check the spelling.
home.recent_empty: Games you launch from here will appear in this list.

detail.no_accounts: Add a Roblox account to play from the launcher.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.subtitle: Your Roblox accounts. Each one can run in its own instance.
accounts.empty_body: Add an account: you confirm the sign-in on roblox.com in your browser, the launcher never sees your password.

delete_confirm.title: Delete {name}?
delete_confirm.body: The account and its saved session are removed from this launcher. Your Roblox account itself is not affected.

accounts.security_note: Sessions are encrypted with Windows DPAPI and can only be read by your Windows user on this PC. Exports contain names only, never sessions.
accounts.relogin_other: You signed in as {name}, a different account: it was added or refreshed separately.
accounts.imported: {count} account(s) imported. Sign in to each one to use it.
accounts.import_invalid: This file is not a valid account export.

instances.title: Instances
instances.subtitle: Every Roblox client started from the launcher.
instances.empty_body: Open a game from Home and press Play to start an instance.

close_confirm.title: Close this instance?
close_confirm.body: The Roblox window of {account} will be closed. Unsaved progress in the game may be lost.

launch.details_missing: Game details are still loading. Try again in a moment.

same_account.title: Account already in game
same_account.body: This account already has a running instance. Roblox may disconnect the first one if you start another. Continue anyway?

login.title: Add a Roblox account
login.requesting: Getting a sign-in code from Roblox…
login.step1: Roblox has opened in your browser. If you are not signed in there, sign in as usual with the account you want to add.
login.step2: Enter this code on the page:
login.step3: Confirm "Do you want to log in to…" on roblox.com. The launcher notices it on its own.
login.waiting_code: Waiting for the code to be entered…
login.waiting_confirm: Code entered for {name}: confirm the sign-in in your browser.
login.privacy: Your password is only typed on roblox.com, never in the launcher. The session received is stored encrypted on this PC.

tray.still_running: The launcher is still running here. Use the tray icon to open it or exit.

error.network: Cannot reach Roblox. Check your internet connection.
error.timeout: Roblox took too long to answer. Try again.
error.tls: The secure connection to Roblox could not be verified.
error.rate_limited: Too many requests to Roblox. Wait a minute and try again.
error.api: Roblox returned an unexpected answer. Try again later.
error.parse: Roblox returned data the launcher could not read.
error.unauthorized: The session of this account has expired. Sign in again.
error.crypto: The saved session could not be decrypted. Sign in again for this account.
error.not_installed: Roblox is not installed on this PC. Install it from roblox.com/download.
error.instance_limit: Instance limit reached ({max}). Close an instance or raise the limit in Settings.
error.instance_limit_single: Roblox is already running. Close it, or enable multiple instances in Settings.
error.account_busy: This account already has a running instance.
error.account_disabled: This account is disabled. Enable it in Accounts.
error.launch_failed: Roblox did not start. Make sure Roblox is installed and up to date.
error.multi_unavailable: Close every Roblox window first: multiple instances can only be enabled before Roblox starts.
error.login_expired: The sign-in code expired or is no longer valid. Try again to get a new one.
error.login_challenge: Roblox asked for an extra verification for this sign-in. Try again in a few minutes.
error.io: Could not write the launcher data files. Check disk space and permissions.
error.d3d: Could not initialise Direct3D 11. Update your graphics drivers.

theme.label: Theme
theme.desc: "Follow system" uses the Windows app colour mode.

animations.label: Animations
animations.desc: Smooth transitions between screens and on buttons.

restore.label: Reopen last screen
restore.desc: Start on the screen you were using when you closed the launcher.

autostart.label: Start with Windows
autostart.desc: Launch automatically when you sign in to Windows.

minimized.label: Start minimized to tray
minimized.desc: When started with Windows, stay in the notification area.

close_to_tray.label: Close to tray
close_to_tray.desc: The close button hides the window instead of quitting.

multi.label: Allow multiple instances
multi.desc: Lets several Roblox windows run at the same time.
multi.warning: Roblox does not officially support multiple clients. Use at your own risk: read the README before enabling it.

max.label: Maximum simultaneous instances
max.desc: Further launches are blocked with a warning.

delay.label: Delay between launches
delay.desc: Waiting between instances avoids conflicts at startup.

thumbs.label: Thumbnail cache size
thumbs.desc: Oldest thumbnails are removed above this limit.

recent.label: Recent games to keep
recent.desc: How many games the Recent list remembers.

api_ttl.label: API cache lifetime
api_ttl.desc: How long search and game details are reused before refreshing.

history_confirm.title: Clear recent games?
history_confirm.body: The Recent list is emptied and For You goes back to popular games.

reset_confirm.title: Reset everything?
reset_confirm.body: Removes all accounts and their sessions, recent games, favorites and cache, and restores default settings. This cannot be undone.

about.disclaimer: Not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Roblox Corporation. "Roblox" is a trademark of Roblox Corporation.

toast.settings_corrupt: The settings file was damaged and has been reset to defaults. A backup was saved as {file}.
toast.file_corrupt: {file} was damaged: a backup was kept and the list starts empty.
toast.settings_save_failed: Could not save settings. Check the disk space and permissions of the data folder.
toast.autostart_failed: Could not change the Windows startup setting.
